# CANDIDATE: GAP_FADE_WITH_VOLUME_CLIMAX

**Filed:** 2026-07-22  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Opening gaps accompanied by unusually high volume (climax) often represent exhausted momentum or liquidity-driven imbalances that reverse within the first hour. This fade opportunity exists because extreme volume at the open frequently signals climax buying/selling rather than sustained institutional interest, leading to mean reversion as the market digests the initial shock.

## Mechanism

Calculate overnight gap as (today's open - prior close). If |gap| > 0.2% of price and opening bar volume > 2× the average 5-bar volume, monitor subsequent 5-minute bars. Enter at the close of the first bar that: (1) closes back inside the prior day's range (price crosses the opposite side of the gap), and (2) has a real body > 60% of its total range. Go long for gap downs, short for gap ups. Place initial stop beyond the gap extreme (gap high for shorts, gap low for longs). Set initial target at 1.5R. If target is hit, trail runner with a premium stop at 0.3% of entry price. Only trade within first 60 minutes after open and when VIX < 20; avoid gap days coinciding with major economic releases (FOMC, CPI, NFP, mega-cap earnings).
